GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproduction.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproduction.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproduction.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproduction.

   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

   B. Primary consumers only

   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

13. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
